display.purpose: Page titles only. Used once per page at the top of the content area.

body.purpose: Default text, descriptions, table cell content. Max line length not constrained (data tables are wide).

mono.purpose: Employee IDs, payroll figures, timestamps, code.

shadows.name: default
shadows.purpose: Cards, popovers, dropdowns. Barely visible by design.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black background, white text, primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #000000; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Muted red background, delete/remove actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #a13d3d; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #ebebeb; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; height: 38px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #ebebeb; border-radius: 0.5rem; }

narrative.overview: Kolonios is a business tool first — a workspace where HR staff and employees get things done without friction. The visual system is restrained, high-contrast, and typography-led. Decoration is absent; clarity and scanability are the only ornaments. The default Vercel theme establishes the baseline: black primary, minimal shadows, generous whitespace, and a monochrome hierarchy that lets colored status badges and chart data carry the only vivid color.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome-first: primary actions use black/white; color is reserved for data, status, and feedback
High scanability: generous whitespace, clear section dividers, consistent 0.5rem radius
Theme-switchable: 10 themes share identical component APIs via CSS custom properties
Mobile-staff reality: bottom nav, horizontal-scrolling tables, collapsible sidebar

rules.name: The Monochrome Priority Rule
rules.body: The primary palette is black, white, and grays. Color is reserved for semantic feedback (red = error, green = success in non-default themes) and chart data. Never add decorative color to empty states, illustrations, or background elements.

rules.name: The Data Density Rule
rules.body: Body text is 0.875rem (14px), not 1rem. HR and payroll data is dense; larger text wastes vertical space and forces unnecessary scrolling in tables.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, popover open, dropdown visible). Cards have borders, not shadows, in their default state.

rules.name: The Consistent Radius Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element uses the same 0.5rem radius. Buttons, inputs, cards, dialogs, and dropdowns must never mix radius values within the same surface.

dos: Do use the `columnPinning: { right: ['actions'] }` pattern for all TanStack Tables so action buttons stay visible while scrolling on mobile
Do wrap tables in `overflow-x-auto` containers to enable horizontal scroll on mobile
Do use `PageContainer` with `overflow-x-hidden` on every page to prevent desktop-feel horizontal overflow
Do use Geist Sans as the primary font (or DM Sans only in Neobrutualism theme)
donts: Don't add decorative illustrations, hero images, or background patterns — this is a business tool where every pixel must earn its place
Don't use rounded-full pills for buttons (except icon-only); stick to 0.5rem radius
Don't introduce colors outside the token system for decorative purposes; use only `primary`, `destructive`, `muted`, and chart tokens
Don't nest cards inside cards — use flat sections with border dividers instead
